impact.text: The user's deposit suffers immediate and irreversible dilution because they overpaid for shares based on a temporarily inflated Net Asset Value (NAV).

precondition_sources.text: A user initiates a deposit request via requestDeposit.
Before the deposit is finalized, the system records accrued yield via adjustBalance, increasing totalAssets in the Investment side and consequently the Price Per Share (PPS).

intent_sources.text: fulfillDeposit must never execute against a reversible value.
